description: Start a Live Activity remotely on the devices that registered a push-to-start token for activityType: iOS 17.2+ through APNs, and Android Live Updates through FCM on apps that observe the same type name with the Sequenzy Android SDK (promoted on Android 16, an ongoing notification before). Target one contact (email or subscriberId), or every contact in a segment, list or tag (exactly one of segmentId, listId, tag; up to 100,000 devices, needs campaigns:send), then update and end it with broadcast: true. Requires an alert. Returns tokenCount 0 without sending when no device can start it; contactCount and platforms count contacts and devices per platform. Repeating the call starts another copy.

activityId.description: Your id for this activity, e.g. "order-1234" (1-128 letters, digits, ".", ":", "-", "_"). Start sets it; update and end target it.

activityType.description: Swift ActivityAttributes type name exactly, e.g. DeliveryAttributes. Android apps observe the same name.

alert.description: Alert shown with the push: title and/or body, plus an optional sound name such as "default".

attributes.description: Static attributes as a JSON object with every field of the app's attributes struct; iOS silently drops a start whose attributes do not decode. Sequenzy adds sequenzy.activityId.

companyId.description: Company ID. If not provided, uses the currently selected company.

contentState.description: Your Swift ContentState as a JSON object; Android apps receive the same object in their Live Update renderer. Date fields decode as seconds since 2001-01-01 on iOS unless your struct decodes them differently.

email.description: Contact whose devices start it. Provide email or subscriberId, or one of segmentId, listId, tag.

listId.description: Start it for every contact in this list (ignored when email or subscriberId is set).

relevanceScore.description: Orders a person's concurrent activities; higher shows first (0-1000000).

segmentId.description: Start it for every contact in this segment instead of one contact (ignored when email or subscriberId is set).

staleDate.description: When iOS shows the activity as out of date: Unix seconds or an ISO 8601 date.

tag.description: Start it for every contact with this tag: one tag name, no commas (ignored when email or subscriberId is set).

name: start_live_activity

outputSchema.description: Structured content returned by the `start_live_activity` MCP tool.

contactCount.description: Distinct contacts those devices belong to: 0 when nothing was sent, at most 1 for a per-contact call, and the contacts reached for a segment, list, tag or broadcast.

items.description: Fallback array wrapper used only when a tool returns a bare array.

jobIds.description: Queued delivery job IDs, one per batch.

items.description: One item in the returned collection.

message.description: Human-readable status, confirmation, or next-step message.

platforms.description: tokenCount per platform: {ios, android}. iOS goes through APNs, Android Live Updates through FCM.

tokenCount.description: Devices the push was queued for; 0 means nothing was sent.

value.description: Fallback object wrapper used only when a tool returns a non-object value.

warnings.description: Non-fatal cautions about content, permissions, or follow-up actions.
